## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: Atomic deletion + static-import-scan + pre_cutover.py AST inspection + IMPORTLIB SMOKE TEST POST-DELETION (this task provides the runtime smoke fixture beyond the simple module-import check in task-6)

Add a runtime smoke test fixture in tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_post_deletion_smoke.py:
1. Import dso_reconciler top-level — assert no ImportError
2. For every (direction, action) tuple in _LEAVES.keys(), call apply(Mutation(direction, action, target, ...)) with a mock acli client — assert each leaf either succeeds OR raises an expected error (DirectionMismatchError, UnknownActionError, StatusMappingError, NotImplementedError if leaf intentionally unimplemented per @pending registry) — NOT ModuleNotFoundError or ImportError
3. Import pre_cutover and invoke any entry points it exposes — assert no ImportError / ModuleNotFoundError / AttributeError
4. Each test asserts the exception class is in the expected-allowed set

## Test Approach
Given the post-deletion reconciler tree; When apply() is invoked across all (direction, action) entries + pre_cutover entry points; Then no ModuleNotFoundError / ImportError surfaces — only domain errors (DirectionMismatchError, UnknownActionError, StatusMappingError) or NoOp.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_post_deletion_smoke.py
- [ ] Smoke test exercises every _LEAVES entry without ModuleNotFoundError
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_post_deletion_smoke.py::test_all_leaves_invocable_without_import_error
- [ ] pre_cutover entry points smoke pass
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_post_deletion_smoke.py::test_pre_cutover_no_import_errors

## File Impact
- tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_post_deletion_smoke.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
